paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of data entries across different task categories. The dataset primarily consists of Math (29.3%), Coding (24.3%), and Information Seeking (22.2%) tasks, followed by Reasoning (10.4%), Planning (2.3%), Creative Writing (2.2%), and other combined categories (9.3%).
model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of different categories within a dataset of 1.4 million data entries. The chart is divided into seven slices, representing Math (410,756), Coding (339,907), Information (311,427), Reasoning (145,329), Planning (31,757), Creative Writing (30,144), and Others (combined) (130,671). The largest slice, Math, occupies approximately 29.3% of the total, while Coding accounts for approximately 24.3% and Information seeks 22.2% of the data entries. The slice for Reasoning is approximately 10.4%, Planning about 2.3%, Creative Writing accounts for 2.2%, and the combined ‘Others’ category represents approximately 9.3% of the dataset. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each individual slice, and a legend is not present.
